launch_gate.rule: No P9 run before P7 completes and GPUs verify clean (clean-GPU snapshot convention).
launch_gate.cohort: Single hardware cohort for all P9 wall-time comparisons; per-method conda envs are part of each system (recorded, disclosed, never mixed within a method's own runs).

scope: SYSTEM_LEVEL_CONTEXT only: each method's intended training system is preserved verbatim (native recipe, native resolution behavior, native densification/pruning, native optimizer). The table situates the matched benchmark among speed-focused systems; it NEVER supports renderer-level winner claims (see reporting_rules).

speedy_splat.submodules: speedy-splat-rasterizer b38abb6da7a7217999f8c5ec0e9219284464ffe0, simple-knn 44f764299fa305faf6ec5ebd99939e0508331503, SIBR_viewers 14199886ae3f42358092c16ada909c1e0b1cba20 (submodule pointers identical to P5; superproject pin moved, P5 pin b9dd42d1 unresolvable upstream)
speedy_splat.env: conda strong_native: python 3.10, torch 2.1.0+cu118, CUDA 11.8 (A100-PCIE validated)
speedy_splat.recipe: native train.sh verbatim: train.py -s <data> -m <out> --eval --iterations 30000 --test_iterations 30000 --save_iterations 30000; -i images default, auto-1600px; score-based pruning from iter 6000 (80% during densify window, 30% after 15k, every 3000)
speedy_splat.metrics_pipeline: render.py + metrics.py (PSNR, SSIM 11x11, LPIPS-VGG) + compute_scene_metrics.py (FPS from kernel_times, 20 repeats)
known_prior_gaps: bicycle/kitchen wall entries were 0.0 (missing) in the P5 ledger - must be re-measured

fastgs.recipe: native train_base.sh verbatim per-scene table (adapter-embedded, transcribed from the frozen upstream file): densification_interval 500, optimizer default, per-scene grad_abs_thresh/dense/highfeature_lr/loss_thresh/mult; render.py --mult then metrics.py
fastgs.eps2d: graphdeco-form: hardcoded cov-diag +0.3 (compact-box mult changes tile assignment, not the covariance filter)
fastgs.metrics_pipeline: render.py + metrics.py (PSNR, SSIM 11x11, LPIPS-VGG); N from trained model
known_prior_gaps: playroom -0.79 dB unexplained in the c42 cohort (native re-run will re-observe)
fastgs.re_gate: 3-scene re-gate required (pin changed from the P5-era tree to upstream main)

faster_gs.env: conda nericg: python 3.11, torch 2.7.1+cu118, CUDA 11.8 (NeRFICG framework env)
faster_gs.recipe: NeRFICG config-driven: adapter-generated per-scene YAML from fastergs_garden.yaml base (PATH=canonical scene, IMAGE_SCALE_FACTOR 0.25 mipnerf360 / 1.0 tanksandtemples+deepblending, TEST_STEP 8, PPISP off, MCMC off, ITERATIONS 30000, RANDOM_SEED 0); scripts/train.py -c <yaml>
faster_gs.eps2d: custom-form: dilation 0.3 (dilation_proper_antialiasing 0.1 only when proper antialiasing enabled; off in the native recipe)
faster_gs.metrics_pipeline: NeRFICG built-in test-set render + torchmetrics PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS; N parsed from train.log 'final number of Gaussians'
known_prior_gaps: native PSNR was 1-4 dB below fastgs/speedy on most scenes in the c42 cohort (suspected underperforming native baseline) - native re-run will re-observe

dataset.layout: canonical 13-scene layout via baseline_closure/adapters/dataset_adapter.py (--emit-args produces each system's invocation)
dataset.garden_rule: P9 uses the CANONICAL garden scene. The P5-era manually-created garden variant is retired; its caveat remains permanently attached to old evidence and is NOT inherited by P9 rows.
dataset.resolution: each system's native behavior, recorded per run (speedy/fastgs: -i images auto-1600px; faster_gs: IMAGE_SCALE_FACTOR 0.25/1.0)

report_fields_per_run: densification_pruning_strategy (free-text summary + link to freeze entry)
lpips_variant (speedy/fastgs: VGG via metrics.py; faster_gs: torchmetrics net per NeRFICG config - recorded, never silently compared across variants)
instrumentation_requirements: VRAM: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() at end of training + nvidia-smi snapshot in provenance (peak memory is eval-independent and comparable at SYSTEM level)
Wall: training-loop wall time (train start -> final save), same definition for all three systems; scheduler records outer wall too (both reported)
N: final Gaussian count read from the trained model, not the log alone (log value recorded as cross-check where available)
Contamination: per-run nvidia-smi snapshot; SYSTEM-level timing on a shared GPU is disclosed via the contamination flag (P5 precedent), though the clean-GPU convention is preferred

run_matrix.native: 3 systems x 13 scenes, native protocol = 39 runs (1-seed; seed is each system's upstream default and recorded)
run_matrix.gates: 3-scene re-gate per system BEFORE the 13-scene expansion (pins moved since P5); gate criteria: RC=0, sane N, sane PSNR vs P5 native rows (expected ranges in the freeze), wall recorded

reporting_rules: Every P9 table is labeled SYSTEM_LEVEL_CONTEXT.
NO renderer-level winner claims from P9 rows. The table reports training time / PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS / N / VRAM / iterations / resolution / densification strategy as system facts.
Wall comparisons across systems are disclosed as system-level timing (each system couples renderer + densification + optimizer + loop).
LPIPS variants are recorded per row and never averaged across variants.
Any garden anomaly is reported per-scene with the data provenance stated (canonical layout), never generalized.
validation: Every run must pass: python baseline_closure/BASELINE_VALIDATION.py --run-dir <dir> --manifest baseline_closure/P9_SYSTEM_CONTEXT_MANIFEST.json --arm <system> --scene <scene> (native-expectation mode: commit/binary/scene/resolution/iterations recorded-and-consistent, contamination check, NaN/Inf check, final evaluation presence).
prohibited: Forcing P8 matched controls onto P9 systems (their iteration counts, densification budgets, pruning are part of the method)
Reusing the P5-era manually-created garden data variant
